title: Implement Trie Prefix Tree
summary: Build an initially empty Trie with insert, search and startsWith.

contractDetails.constraints: At most 30,000 calls. Every word and prefix contains 1–2,000 lowercase English letters. In the fixture, each row is [operation, text]. Only search and startsWith produce results, encoded as 1 or 0 in call order.

statement: Build an initially empty Trie with insert, search and startsWith. Insert stores a word. Search tests whether that entire word was inserted. StartsWith tests whether any stored word begins with the supplied prefix, including an equal word. Duplicate inserts leave the set of words unchanged.

examples.explanation: The prefix exists without being a complete word.
The first query precedes insertion. A repeated insert does not remove the word.
Both terminal words coexist, and cat has no path.

constraints: At most 30,000 calls. Every word and prefix contains 1–2,000 lowercase English letters. In the fixture, each row is [operation, text]. Only search and startsWith produce results, encoded as 1 or 0 in call order.
hints: Conceptual: Words with the same prefix can share the first part of their representation.
Directional: Give each node child links and a flag marking a complete word.
Implementation: Walk or create edges on insert. For search require the final flag, while startsWith needs only a complete path.
complexityAnalysis: O(L) time per operation for length L and O(S) storage for S distinct prefix nodes, assuming a fixed alphabet or constant-time child lookup.
